name: context-canvas-codex
description: Local, evidence-pointer-only task maps for Codex App and CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Map and recover evidence-backed task state.
interface.longDescription: Keeps bounded task facts, dependencies, and hash-bound evidence pointers in a local Windows-hardened store shared by Codex App, Codex CLI, and a bundled MCP server. It never captures tool output or reads evidence content.
defaultPrompt: Create a safe checkpoint for this long-running task.
Restore this task's active blockers after compaction.
Search this task's pointer-only Context Canvas and prepare a closeout.
